issue.title: Dependency management for Netty is incomplete

repository.name: spring-boot
repository.description: Spring Boot helps you to create Spring-powered, production-grade applications and services with absolute minimum fuss.

issue.body: Netty's bom is missing dependency management for its three `netty-transport-native-*` modules. See https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/6738 for details. As a result, `reactor-netty` is pulling in a mixture of Netty 4.1.9 and 4.1.11.

issue.title: Correctly include native modules

repository.name: netty
repository.description: Netty project - an event-driven asynchronous network application framework

issue.body:
Motivation:

We need to include the native modules on the bom to ensure there is no version missmatch.

Modifications:

Add native modules.

Result:

Fixes [#6738]
